nodes.description: The primary goal of the project: to detect and localize surgical tools in images and videos.
A fast, real-time object detection model based on a convolutional neural network architecture (local context).
An object detection model based on the Transformer architecture, using attention for global context analysis.
The structured environment and methodology for comparing YOLOv8 and DETR.
Core concept of Transformers, allowing the model to weigh the importance of different parts of the input data (global context).
Core concept of CNNs, using filters to process input data in a local neighborhood.
Mean Average Precision, a standard metric for evaluating the accuracy of object detectors.
Measures the stability of bounding boxes across consecutive video frames. Key for the research hypothesis.
Measures the consistency of detection over time, penalizing models for losing track of objects.
The core assumption that DETR's attention mechanism provides superior temporal stability over YOLO's local approach.
